# Variable.Value

```m
Variable.Value(identifier as text) as any
```

Returns the value of the specified variable `identifier` defined by the current evaluation environment. If the variable is not defined, an error is raised.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | `text` | no |
